name: Workhorse checkouts
responsibility: Names the checkout a coordinator call gives work to, and starts that checkout's workhorse when a delegation finds none
description: A path names a checkout only when the host's resolveCheckout admits it, spelled as a real path, so a checkout reached through a link is the same checkout. Archboard admits the directory that holds the vault the path resolves to, in the layout its server serves: a directory that holds a .archboard/vault, or the directory that holds a vault the path is. Of the coordinator's tools only a delegation starts a workhorse; the other three refuse a checkout that has none. A workhorse that cannot be built or started, because its tab has gone, leaves the delegation to refuse, so the coordinator's turn is always answered.

outgoing.label: start its thread when it has none that can run turns
